CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayInsertAt

Inserts a new element at the given position. The element that was there, and every element after it, moves up one position.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayInsertAt(array, position, value)

Parameters

array
The array to change.
position
Where the new element goes, from 1 to ArrayLen(array) + 1. Using ArrayLen(array) + 1 is the same as ArrayAppend.
value
The value to insert.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

Any other position throws an Expression exception ("Array index out of range"). To replace an element without shifting the others, simply assign it: <CFSET MyArray[2] = "new">.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Planets = ListToArray("Mercury,Earth,Mars")>
<CFSET Temp = ArrayInsertAt(Planets, 2, "Venus")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Position</TH><TH>Planet</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Planets)#">
<TR><TD ALIGN="CENTER">#i#</TD><TD>#Planets[i]#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayAppend, ArrayPrepend, ArrayDeleteAt, ListInsertAt
